title.zh: 【Diamante 遭安全事件，正协调暂停受影响资产的提现与转账】
title.en: 【Diamante 遭安全事件，正协调暂停受影响资产的提现与转账】

current_state.zh: Layer 1 blockchain Diamante disclosed a security incident involving unauthorized actions by malicious actors, activated emergency measures, and is coordinating with exchanges, market makers, and liquidity providers to suspend withdrawals and transfers of affected assets while pursuing a suspect with law enforcement and pledging full compensation.
current_state.en: Layer 1 blockchain Diamante disclosed a security incident involving unauthorized actions by malicious actors, activated emergency measures, and is coordinating with exchanges, market makers, and liquidity providers to suspend withdrawals and transfers of affected assets while pursuing a suspect with law enforcement and pledging full compensation.
